verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is a first-party serverless framework that runs backend code automatically in the background. It can be triggered by events, Authentication and Cloud Storage triggers, HTTPS requests, or Cloud Scheduler jobs, and is deployed with one CLI command, so autonomous background automation is a real product capability. However, every automation must be hand-written as code, and nothing in the evidence shows AI-driven or agentic setup or execution; the MCP server and Gemini features are interactive assistance, not autonomous background runs. An older community complaint about missing scheduled tasks predates the documented Cloud Scheduler support and does not contradict it. Missing for 10: AI-native or agentic automation setup (natural-language or agent-defined background tasks), no-code automation configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled and background runs.
